newsitem.title: INDIA: India cotton prices mixed ahead of officials' meet.
newsitem.headline: India cotton prices mixed ahead of officials' meet.

text.p: Indian cotton prices were mixed on low volumes on Thursday ahead of a key official meeting later in the day to discuss cotton demand and supply, dealers said.
They said the trade was awaiting the outcome of a meeting by the Cotton Advisory Board called by the textile commissioner.

Punjab varieties recovered from recent losses while Gujarat cotton was unchanged. In spot deals Bengal-deshi rose by 15 rupees to 890/915 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned gained by 10 rupees to 1,540/1,640.
In Gujarat cotton, Gujarat Sankar-4 (long-staple) was steady at 18,000/19,000 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
